hint.cam_diagnose: The step by step check shows where the problem is: network, password, camera or Valo.
hint.cam_dir: A folder inside the storage root. The root is set at installation (MEDIA_ROOT in envs), the folder can be changed here. Old recordings stay in the previous folder.
hint.cam_driver: The extension that works with cameras of this brand. The driver checks the camera and reports its streams and motion events.
hint.cam_min_free: When free disk space drops below the threshold, Valo removes its oldest recordings. If there is nothing left to remove, video is not recorded until space appears.
hint.cam_motion: Motion detection runs on the camera itself and must be on for Valo to receive motion events and record clips. Sensitivity 1 is lowest, 8 highest.
hint.cam_ptz: A preset stores the position of a pan and tilt camera. On the camera page arrows turn it, Aim mode turns it to a point on the picture.
hint.cam_record: On events: on motion or detection a snapshot and a clip with margin before and after the event are saved. The last seconds of video are kept in memory, only the clip is written to disk.
hint.cam_settings: Everything about the camera in one place: connection, recording, camera settings, detection, pan and tilt, diagnostics and removal. Each tab is saved separately.
hint.cam_timeline: Bars show continuous recording, ticks show events. Click a bar to play from that minute.
hint.cam_vision: The Camera recognition extension looks for people, cars and animals in frames while the camera sees motion and creates events with a label and a snapshot with a box. Zones limit where objects count, an object belongs to a zone by the place where it stands
hint.dev_devices: Devices are home appliances that are controlled or measure something: connected over Zigbee, over MQTT or through an extension, for example the simulator.
hint.dev_flags: Quick filters: offline devices, devices with low battery and devices with a weak Zigbee signal.
hint.dev_link: Zigbee link quality (LQI) from 0 to 255. Below 60 the link is weak. A router nearby helps: any mains powered Zigbee device, for example a plug.
hint.dev_services: A service is a record an extension creates without an appliance of its own: weather, calendar, timers, energy usage, safety, plug guard. Services can be put on dashboards and used in flows, but they are not counted as devices.
hint.dev_src: How the device is connected to the home. Zigbee through the stick, MQTT through the broker (including HA discovery and manual topic mapping), and for devices connected by an extension the name of that extension is shown.
hint.ext_perms: Permissions show what the extension will do. Reading and controlling devices, notifications and MQTT publishing are checked by the core and refused without a permission. Network access and pages are listed for information, the core does not limit them, so install third party extensions only from trusted sources.
hint.flow_mode: What to do when the event arrives again while the previous run is still going. Single: the new one is skipped. Restart: the previous one stops. Queue: the new one waits. Parallel: both run.
hint.flow_result: The outcome of the last run. Condition not met means the event happened but the conditions stopped it. The step by step trace is in the flow editor.
hint.flow_tpl: A template creates a flow with blocks already connected, you only pick devices and values. Some templates come from extensions.
hint.flows: A flow is a rule: when an event happens (trigger) and the conditions hold, the actions run. For example, on a leak switch off a plug and send a notification. A flow works on its own while it is enabled.
hint.mq_clients: Broker accounts for external devices and programs. Anonymous access is closed, rights are set by roles.
hint.mq_discovery: HA discovery is the Home Assistant standard: the device publishes its own description and Valo creates it without manual setup.
hint.mq_mapping: Mapping turns arbitrary MQTT topics into a device: which topic gives which reading and where commands go.
hint.p_boards: A dashboard gathers the widgets you need on one screen. In Customize mode widgets are added, dragged and resized in grid steps.
hint.p_cameras: Home cameras: the tile snapshot refreshes every 10 seconds, a tap opens live video, motion events and recordings. A camera is connected by a driver installed from the extension catalog.
hint.p_chat: The assistant answers questions about the home and creates dashboards, rooms and widgets. Device commands run only after you confirm them, created items can be undone.
hint.p_device: The device page: controls, current readings, charts and event history. The name and room are changed here too.
hint.p_devices: Everything in the home in two lists. Devices are appliances: Zigbee, MQTT and those connected by extensions. Services are extension records without an appliance of their own, for example weather or calendar.
hint.p_extensions: An extension adds new features: devices and services, pages in the menu, dashboard widgets and flow blocks. Each runs as a separate process and can only do what was allowed at install.
hint.p_home: The overview shows the whole home: the plan with rooms and device icons, climate, energy, scenes and recent events. Click a room to control its devices.
hint.p_log: The log keeps home events: device changes, flow runs, actions of people and extensions. Important events also arrive as notifications.
hint.p_mqtt: MQTT connects devices that are not Zigbee, for example Wi-Fi relays and sensors. The Mosquitto broker receives messages, Valo parses them by mappings and HA discovery.
hint.p_notifications: Active notifications need attention and close by themselves once the cause is gone, or with Dismiss. Closed ones stay in the All list. Each notification has its own page with the full text, the source and log entries.
hint.p_rooms: Rooms group devices and form the home plan by floors. A room can be marked as outdoor, then its sensors count as outdoor sensors.
hint.p_system: Home settings, users and roles, API tokens, backups, the assistant and the node error log.
hint.p_xpage: This page was added by an extension. Its data and buttons are handled by the extension itself, settings and description are on the Extensions page.
hint.p_zigbee: Pairing new Zigbee devices and the network state: coordinator and channel, network map, link quality of each device.
hint.scene_capture: Saves the current state of the scene devices into the scene. Set the devices by hand, then press this button.
hint.scenes: A scene is a saved set of states for several devices, for example lights at 30 percent and a plug off. A scene watches nothing by itself: it is applied with the Apply button, from a dashboard or by a flow action.
hint.sys_ai: Key and model for the assistant. The assistant works through OpenRouter, the key is stored on the node encrypted.
hint.sys_backups: A backup contains the home database (devices, rooms, dashboards, flows, scenes, settings) and the Zigbee2MQTT data. It can be downloaded and uploaded back.
hint.sys_roles: The owner can do everything, including managing administrators. An administrator configures the system, flows and extensions. A resident controls devices and dashboards. A guest only views.
hint.sys_tokens: A token gives an external program access to the Valo API with the rights of the chosen role. The token is shown once, keep it like a password.
hint.sys_z2m_alert: Zigbee2MQTT sometimes loses the stick for a few seconds and reconnects by itself. Such a drop only goes to the event log. The alert is sent if the connection stays down longer than this, and an all clear follows when it is back. 0 means alert at once.
hint.w_size: Width is 1 or 2 columns. Height is a multiple of the 164 pixel grid step: auto picks the smallest step that fits the content, the rest scrolls inside.
hint.zb_map: The map shows which devices carry the traffic. Mains powered devices act as routers and pass the signal on, battery devices connect to them.
hint.zb_pair: Opens the network for new devices during the countdown. Put the device into pairing mode as its manual says, usually by a long button press, and keep it near the stick.
